<thought>We need a retrosynthetic template that, when applied to the target molecule, removes a TBS protecting group. In the forward direction the reaction forms a t‑butyldimethylsilyl group and breaks an aliphatic hydroxyl. Therefore, in retrosynthesis the template should break the t‑butyldimethylsilyl group and form an aliphatic hydroxyl. We'll search the template catalog for templates with functional_groups_broken=["t-butyldimethylsilyl"] and functional_groups_formed=["aliphatic hydroxyls"].</thought>
<action>search_template_catalog_by_criteria</action>
<action_input>{
    "molecule_smiles": "O[C@H]1C[C@@H](O[C@@H]([C@@H]1C)/C=C(CO)/C)C/C=C/C=C/C(O)=O",
    "functional_groups_broken": ["t-butyldimethylsilyl"],
    "functional_groups_formed": ["aliphatic hydroxyls"],
    "limit": 5
}</action_input>
